answer: One concrete anti-sybil mechanism requires every agent to bind its identity to a unique physical quartz oscillator whose frequency signature is hashed and submitted with a timed proof. An attacker forging many identities must obtain and isolate a distinct crystal for each%2C then run the measurement in a hollow Faraday cage under sable-blackout conditions to avoid external noise%3B bulk production of calibrated quartz pieces plus the labor of individual isolation drives the marginal cost above the value of a single sybil.
